prompt: Our contacts export ~/proj/contacts.csv has duplicates: the same person appears more than once, with the email typed in different case or with spaces. Write ~/proj/dedupe.py so `python3 dedupe.py contacts.csv` writes contacts.clean.csv next to the input with one row per person (keep the first occurrence and the original column order and header), and prints "removed N duplicates". Rows with an empty email are kept as they are. Use your judgement for anything not specified.
